documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: Support for PLA
Bambu Support for PLA Safety Data Sheet SDS20250928S02
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its colour value "White (65104)" has no published hex.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for glass transition, Vicat softening, heat deflection (1.8 and 0.45 MPa) and every mechanical row (Young's modulus, tensile strength, breaking elongation, bending modulus, bending strength, impact strength; X-Y and Z); the SDS section 9 says "No data available.". Filament length and hardness are stated nowhere.

Document dates: the TDS (V1.0; PDF created 2025-03-17) predates the SDS (SDS20250928S02, 2025-09-28); both are the documents this page's Download block links for "Support for PLA (New Version)", so both are used. The TDS states no composition, so it does not contradict the SDS.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: melt index 13.6 ± 1.2 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature N/A, saturated water absorption rate 0.43% (25 °C, 55% RH), spool material ABS (temperature resistance 70 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), retraction length 0.6 - 1.0 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C (thermal.chamber_temp is the printer chamber key), max overhang angle 55°, max bridging length 30 mm, support "Turn On", odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.
material.spool_type is neither stored nor listed as not_published: the TDS gives the spool material (ABS, 70 °C) and the store Type value is "Filament with spool", but no source names a spool type.
SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "S02-xx", CLP "Not classified.", no hazard pictogram, "Not hazardous goods" for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO-TI/IATA transport, SVHC "Not listed".

Moisture wording differs between official sources (no stored key): the support wiki overview says "Low moisture sensitivity; minimal drying or humidity control required." and 2.1 "Pre-print Drying: No special requirements", while its Important note 3 calls Support for PLA "highly hygroscopic"; the drying wiki Appendix I says "Recommended"; the store Printing Tips (4.Safety Tips) say "As this filament is highly moisture-absorbent".

Store page copy to review: its Printing Tips › 4.Safety Tips carry a sub-bullet "As this filament contains highly hygroscopic wood fibers…", which neither the TDS nor the SDS composition supports (apparent template text from another filament).

Marketing prose is not used for numbers: the "0mm top interface spacing and 0mm Z-distance settings" footnote (feature block 2) and the percentage comparison with the predecessor (feature block 3) are not stored.

Not cached, so not read: the store page's "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/s2/default/2c70364d5ac142568d2a6bc1fc2cd088/Bambu_Support_For_PLA_RoHS.pdf; safety.certifications is left to review and not listed as not_published) and the wiki page https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/support (slicer support settings) linked from the Printing Tips.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.05 mm) comes from the store page only (Product Features › bullet 5) and is written by the page layer (verified, official_page); it is not repeated here.
